title: wb is not a command a person can type
desc:
The README writes wb everywhere, but only skills have it: a person in a terminal has to type python "<plugin root>/lib/wb.py". Around it: an unknown command answers with the usage line as its fix; doctor, init and task new print absolute paths three times the width of the message.

ACCEPTANCE:
- a launcher script (bin/wb, bin/wb.cmd) runs lib/wb.py with the current python; README says how to put it on PATH
- an unknown command or action suggests the closest name (difflib) as its fix
- paths inside the checkout print repo-relative in doctor, init and task new
- README opens with a five-command quickstart
- tests for the suggestion and the relative paths
